item.title: Twardzik Honors Pottsville Maroons with Centennial Resolution
item.description: State Rep. Tim Twardzik (R-Schuylkill) announced the passage of House Resolution 277, officially designating Aug. 16, 2025, as Pottsville Maroons Championship Day in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, marking the 100th anniversary of one of the most storied teams in football history. The resolution recognizes the historic 1925 season of the Pottsville Maroons, a professional football team based in Schuylkill County and made up largely of local coal miners.
